shortDescription: The Dow Jones Index decreased 162 points or 0.31 percent on Thursday to close at 51350 points.The decline was led by Walmart (-2.67%), IBM (-2.44%) and Sherwin-Williams (-1.90%).On the upside, the strongest performers were Walt Disney (2.03%), Visa (1.79%) and American Express (1.11%).

title: The Dow Jones Index Closes 0.31% Lower
